compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined The wilderness generation is refused entry beside The land is said to vomit out its inhabitants; Scattering is threatened and covenant is remembered; Scattering and seeking are held together; Curse ends in siege, scattering, and return to Egypt. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
